meaning: Act-1 coffee-break driver entry: dispatches on the cutscene sub-state byte #4e06 via the 7-word table at #210c (sub-states 0..6). The whole act-1 scene is this position-threshold machine, not a frame-counted animation.
Sub-state 0 ends when Pac's tile byte #4d3a == #21 (Pac walks in from the start tile while Blinky is frozen). `sub #21` on the tile byte.
Sub-state 1 (the chase, both actors moving) ends when Pac's tile byte #4d3a == #1e (reached via the 8-bit tile-counter wrap). `sub #1e`.
Sub-state 2 (Blinky alone) ends when Blinky's tile byte #4d32 == #1e; on that edge the ROM frightens all ghosts (#1a70) and reverses the actors (#05a5). `sub #1e`.
Sub-state 4 (the frightened Blinky fleeing, reversed vector) ends when Blinky's tile byte #4d32 == #2f. `sub #2f`.
Sub-state 5 (big-Pac chasing, both moving) ends when Blinky's tile byte #4d32 == #3d. `sub #3d`.
Sub-state 6 (big-Pac closing) ends — and the whole scene ends — when Pac's tile byte #4d3a == #3d. `sub #3d`.
Act-1 actor-layout routine #260f seeds Pac's tile pair #4d39/#4d3a with the word #1f32 -> the high (tile) byte #4d3a = #1f, Pac's cutscene start column.
Act-1 actor-layout routine #260f seeds the ghost tile pairs (#4d31/#4d33/#4d35/#4d37) with the word #1e32 -> the high (tile) byte = #1e, Blinky's cutscene start column, one tile behind Pac.

big-Pac sprite routine #15e6 reads #4e06 and `sub #05; ret c` (#15e9/#15eb): the big-Pac (four 16x16 sprites, colour #16) is drawn ONLY when the cutscene sub-state >= 5 — i.e. from the return leg onward.
Pac's normal mouth animation reads the sprite pixel low byte #4d09 and masks `and #07` (#168f): 4 mouth images across an 8-pixel cycle (a new image every 2px, thresholds 2/4/6 at #1691..#16a7).

The return-leg Blinky is the BLUE FRIGHTENED sprite: the frighten-all routine #1a70 sets the ghost sprite image to #1c (`ld (ix+#02),#1c`) with colour #11. This is act 1's chased-back ghost — NOT the ripped sheet (#32/#33, #162d, act 2).
